title: TOD blocker resolution operating rules
goal: TOD must turn every blocker into a resolved, parked, narrowed, or escalated state with evidence and a prevention rule.
operator_rule: All blockers must be resolved or transformed into an accountable next state. A blocker may not remain as vague blocked_with_evidence without inspected evidence and a next owner/action.

resolution_loop.requirement: Identify blocker from objective, task, dispatcher, artifact, logs, or operator report.
Read linked objective row, task row, task result, evidence artifact, dispatcher status, and relevant logs/code.
Assign one primary blocker class and one confidence score.
Check codebase, existing executors, prior repairs, continuity memory, and current docs/research when the blocker depends on external services or current APIs.
Choose repair, park, supersede, narrow, create repair task, escalate to Codex, or ask Dave only if needed.
Execute the smallest safe action. If code change is needed and TOD lacks executor authority, create a Codex escalation packet with exact files and acceptance criteria.
Prove objective/task/artifact/dispatcher/operator status agree. If not, keep it open.
Record prevention rule and regression check so the same blocker class is handled faster next time.

help_escalation_ladder: create_codex_escalation_packet_with_exact blocker, files, commands, and acceptance criteria
ask_Dave_only_for human preference, credentials, physical-world state, or business decision
